notes.note: Reviewed the Insights UI repair: shared Tabs/ActionRow primary-secondary-overflow, canonical Empty/Skeleton states, precise companion service wording and shared correlation-only UUID fallback. No credential/nonce generator, source/person/operator authority, DTO or retention bound changes. Existing SDK/UI controls were extended for missing randomUUID: baseline failed for the intended SDK/UI operation failures; 27 affected tests passed after repair and UI typecheck passed. Controlled source UI evidence remains separate from backend source authentication, receiver durability and installed acceptance. The obsolete bespoke tab selectors were removed after confirming no JSX caller; shared tab styles own that widget. No real-person/TLS, physical/native, full Profile integration or release qualification is added.
